item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is doing a class experiment in her school in Jaipur. She rolls a bar magnet in a box of iron nails and then lifts it out.
She counts the nails stuck to different parts of the magnet. More nails stick near the two ends, and very few stick in the middle.
Which statement explains her observation?

options.A: The magnet attracts most strongly at its two ends, where its poles are.
options.B: The magnet attracts equally from every part because the whole bar is a magnet.
options.C: The magnet attracts most strongly in the middle and least strongly at its two ends.
options.D: The magnet attracts only iron nails and cannot attract any other material.
